name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 55

clue.text: Blessed initial downpour leads to sudden mental distur- bance!
Mineral inside the metal cover
Tex’s deep in strange contrivances
Sulphur frequently is smooth
Moving by slow degrees — but can you do it with your feet? —
Bound to be a season
.16 Kill, apparently, a cold-climate runner
As active as the objector or the footballer
Remove a dangerous element from French blend
Like upset boys, they’re green!
Take me to crashed plane — then join up with the jury
Looks like melodies
Freed thing reverts to wild state and grows timid
Only missing one letter — the second letter from the end of the stone
You can’t do without them in the assets line
Hard or soft, with a flowery sound?
‘Mischievous things politician is without
Taking part of railway track
High-tension cables that may weigh heavily on unprofitable business?
Masters outside can give service
Whisky encourages the production of food
Earliest sailor picks up novel
Get in trim to deliver new machine under its own power in cross-Channel boat
Anger with an odour of sanctity?
All cigars have two bits snipped off the end, becoming far from hot!
Bite monster flower!
Issue makes me green quite endlessly
Male or female not up to being a church officer
Not in favour of crushing a tin
